reason: Nothing replaces fresh chutney made in our home mixer with real mint and green chillies; packaged green sauces always reek of artificial vinegar.
objection: Packaged green chutney always tastes like chemicals and vinegar, never like fresh homemade dhaniya-pudina
would_change_my_mind: Nothing really, unless someone blind-tastes me on it and it genuinely tastes like freshly ground mint without vinegar.
